items.title: Drift opens exploit recovery claims with initial payouts of just over 1% of user losses
items.whyYouShouldCare: Drift's low initial payout for exploit recovery highlights ongoing vulnerabilities in DeFi, potentially impacting user confidence and liquidity in the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: North Dakota’s Roughrider Coin Goes Live on Fiserv and Solana
items.whyYouShouldCare: The launch of Roughrider Coin on Fiserv and Solana enhances the utility of the Solana network, potentially attracting more users and increasing transaction volume.

items.title: Community banks sue OCC over trust bank charters of crypto firms
items.whyYouShouldCare: The lawsuit against the OCC by community banks over crypto trust charters could influence regulatory frameworks, affecting the operational landscape for Solana-based financial applications.
